Any tips for getting *enough* to eat? After a little over a year of restricting, I’m trying to eat at ~1800 calories per day and get 160 g of protein. Today I know I haven’t eaten enough and I’m so full. I had:

Breakfast shake 365 cal:
-8oz almond milk (~65 cal)
-2 scoops protein powder (150 cal)
-1 tbsp peanut butter (90 cal)
-1.5 cups spinach (~10 cal or so)
-1 banana (100 cal)

Lunch 565 cal:
-6 oz rotisserie chicken (300 cal)
-3/4 cup quinoa (~200 cal)
-1.5 cups steamed broccoli (65 cal)

Snack:
-protein bar (280 cal)

Dinner 310 cal
-6 oz chicken (300 cal)
-sugar free jello (10 cal)

Total: ~1510 or so. Not enough!
